name: Scorecard per Rep
description: Weekly per-rep performance scorecard, as an Attention agent-builder flow: schedule -> askAttention (pull the week's calls per rep, score six dimensions 1-5, compare to last week, pick top-3 coaching priorities) -> post to a channel. CONFIRM against your builder before import: the schema this was modeled on is a per-call agent, so three things here are best-effort and flagged in scorecard-per-rep.md -> Build notes: (1) the @activepieces/piece-schedule trigger + version, (2) the askAttention context scope for a cross-call query, (3) the Slack channel-post action name. Set connections and the placeholder ids (<...>) on import.

nextAction.name: score_reps
nextAction.displayName: Score six dimensions per rep, compare to last week, pick coaching priorities

input.prompt: You are the Scorecard per Rep agent. (1) Pull every team call from the last 7 days and group by rep. If a rep has fewer than 3 calls, score only what is reliable and flag 'Insufficient data for full scorecard'. (2) For each rep, score these six dimensions 1-5 from transcript evidence: Discovery Quality, Objection Handling, Value Articulation, Next-Step Setting, Talk Ratio (5 = rep talks 30-45%, 3 = 50-60%, 1 = over 70%), Question Quality. Compute the rep's average. (3) Compare each dimension to the prior 7-day window and mark improved / declined / stable. (4) Pick the 3 lowest-scoring dimensions per rep; for each, cite one specific call example (timestamp or quote) and give one concrete coaching suggestion. (5) Add a team summary: highest performer, most improved, team average, total calls analyzed. If no calls for any rep, output exactly: 'No calls recorded this period. Scorecard generation skipped.' and stop. Output the exact report format in scorecard-per-rep.md -> Output. Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_report
nextAction.displayName: Post the scorecard to the team channel
